description_en: Batch modifies the SSL configurations of RDS AI application instances
description_zh: 该接口用于批量修改RDS AI应用实例的SSL配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-instances-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-names ra-supabase-xxx --ssl-enabled 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstancesSSL

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs of AI applications. A maximum of 10 instance IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: AI应用的实例ID列表。最多支持10个
parameters.name: instance_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Currently, only custom is supported, which indicates a custom certificate.
This parameter is required when SSLEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型，当前仅支持custom，表示使用自定义证书。
SSLEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: ca_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate content.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
自定义证书内容。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the certificate.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
证书私钥。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_key

InstanceNames.description_en: The list of instance IDs of AI applications that were successfully modified
InstanceNames.description_zh: 修改成功的AI应用的实例ID列表

items.description_en: The instance ID of an AI application that was successfully modified
items.description_zh: 修改成功的AI应用的实例ID
